label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
Moved from Phibsborough to Drumcondra on Saturday 17 October — two-bed flat, but mostly my own stuff, and the new place is a fourth-floor walk-up with no lift. Booked Kilbarrack Van Co through their website, €50 deposit by Revolut, quote was €340 for up to four hours with two lads and the van.

They were due at 9 and landed at half 10. I got a text at 8:40 saying the previous job had overrun, which I did appreciate, better than sitting there guessing, but I was perched on a pile of boxes with a cold coffee by then. So if you're on a tight handover with a landlord, build in an hour and don't be relying on the 9 o'clock. For me it was no harm, I had the day.

Once they were in they worked steadily and it was about three and a half hours all in. €340 was the quote and it was the best value I found — the other quotes I got were €450 and up, and that was before anyone had clapped eyes on the stairs. Dessie knocked €40 off at the end because of the lateness, and I never asked him for it. That says plenty about how he runs the thing.

The couch wasn't going round the turn on the third floor and one of the younger lads had the legs off it with an allen key out of his pocket before I'd even worked out what to suggest. Straight in after that, no drama. They put the bed back together in the new place without being asked and took away a flat-pack shelf I didn't want, which saved me a run to the recycling centre.

The one thing I'd flag: they wrapped everything in blankets except the base of a brass floor lamp, and it got chipped. It was my nanny's, so I was a bit gutted about it. Nothing catastrophic and I didn't kick up a fuss on the day, but lads — wrap the lamps. Anything with a base or a shade, get a blanket round it. That's the only reason this is four stars and not five, and I think four is fair.

Would I use them again? Yeah, honestly. Good value, quick once they got going, careful with the furniture generally, and the two lads were sound. If you're moving in Dublin and you're not up against a hard deadline with a landlord, they're a solid bet. If you are up against a deadline, ring them, tell them, and ask them straight what time they'll actually be there.

Four stars. Wrap the lamps and it's five.
